summary: Matthew Spates, 26, of Fort Collins died after a tubing accident on the Poudre River near Lions Park; nine people with tied-together tubes were pulled from the water, and Spates passed away at 5:30 a.m. Friday July 5
location: Poudre River near Lions Park, LaPorte
notes: The tubes were tied together and snagged on a branch/strainer, entrapping the group; tubes were retail-store purchases not rated for the river. Recorded at the July 4 incident date; death at 5:30 a.m. Friday 2019-07-05.
